q1.explanationZh: comprise“包括；由……构成”，是及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

q2.explanationZh: compulsory“义务的；强制的”，compulsory education“义务教育”。

q3.explanationZh: compute“计算；估计”，加 -r 就是名词 computer“计算机”。

q4.explanationZh: compute“计算”加 -r 构成 computer“计算机”。

q5.explanationZh: conceal“隐藏；隐瞒”，比 hide 更正式；conceal sth. from sb.“对某人隐瞒某事”。

q6.explanationZh: concentrate“集中；专心”，常用 concentrate on“集中精力于”。

q7.explanationZh: concentrate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 concentration“专心；集中”。

q8.explanationZh: concept“概念；观念”，design concept“设计理念”。

q9.explanationZh: concern 作名词“关心；忧虑”，作动词“与……有关；使担心”；be concerned about“关心，担心”。

q10.explanationZh: concert“音乐会”，注意不要和 concern 混淆。

q11.explanationZh: conclude“结束；得出结论”，名词是 conclusion。

q12.explanationZh: conclude 去 de 加 -sion 构成名词 conclusion；in conclusion“最后；总之”。

q13.explanationZh: concrete 名词“混凝土”，形容词“具体的”，concrete evidence“具体证据”。

q14.explanationZh: condition“状况；条件”，表示“工作条件”时常用复数 working conditions。

q15.explanationZh: conduct 作动词“进行；指挥”（重音在后），作名词“品行”（重音在前）。

q16.explanationZh: conduct 加 -or 表示人，conductor“售票员；指挥”。

q17.explanationZh: conference“（正式）会议”，注意中间是 -fer-，结尾是 -ence。

q18.explanationZh: confess“承认；坦白”，confess to (doing) sth.“承认（做了）某事”。

q19.explanationZh: confidence“信心”，have confidence in“对……有信心”。

q20.explanationZh: confident 是 confidence 的形容词，be confident of/that...“对……有信心”。

q21.explanationZh: confirm“证实；确认”，注意是 con + firm。

q22.explanationZh: conflict 作名词“冲突”，也可作不及物动词“相冲突”。

q23.explanationZh: Confucius（孔子）+ -anism 构成 Confucianism“儒教”，专有名词首字母大写。

q24.explanationZh: Confucius“孔子”是专有名词，首字母要大写。

q25.explanationZh: confuse“使困惑”，confuse A with B“把 A 和 B 混淆”。

q26.explanationZh: confused 是形容词“感到困惑的”，多用来说人；confusing 是“令人困惑的”。

q28.explanationZh: congratulate“祝贺”，congratulate sb. on sth.“就某事祝贺某人”。

q29.explanationZh: congratulate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 congratulation，常用复数 Congratulations!

q30.explanationZh: congress“代表大会；立法机关”，注意结尾双写 s。

q31.explanationZh: connect“连接；联系”，注意双写 n；connect A with/to B。

q32.explanationZh: conquer“征服”，注意结尾是 -quer；名词 conqueror“征服者”。

q33.explanationZh: conscience“良心”，a clear conscience“问心无愧”；注意 sc 的拼写。

q34.explanationZh: conscious“意识到的”，be conscious of“意识到”；名词 consciousness。

q35.explanationZh: a clear conscience“问心无愧”，clear 表示“清白的”。

q36.explanationZh: conceal sth. from sb.“对某人隐瞒某事”，介词用 from。

q37.explanationZh: concentrate on“集中精力于”，介词用 on。

q38.explanationZh: be concerned about“关心；担心”，用过去分词 concerned。

q39.explanationZh: as far as ... is concerned“就……而言”，中间填人或事。

q40.explanationZh: concern oneself with/in/about sth.“忙于（关心）某事”，要用反身代词 oneself。

q41.explanationZh: in conclusion“最后；总之”，常用于总结。

q42.explanationZh: on ... condition“在……情况下”，介词用 on；on no condition“决不”。

q43.explanationZh: congratulate sb. on sth.“就某事祝贺某人”，介词用 on。

q44.explanationZh: be conscious of“意识到”，介词用 of。

q45.explanationZh: conduct oneself“表现，为人”，with judgement“有判断力地”。

q46.explanationZh: connect to/with“与……连接”，两个介词都可以。

q47.explanationZh: be confident of“对……有信心”，介词用 of。

q48.explanationZh: conflict of interest“利益冲突”，conflict 作名词。

q49.explanationZh: confuse A with B“把 A 和 B 混淆”，介词用 with。

q50.explanationZh: “我被意思相近的词弄糊涂了”，be confused“感到困惑的”，用形容词 confused。

q51.explanationZh: concrete 作形容词“具体的”，concrete evidence“具体证据”。

q52.explanationZh: conduct an experiment“做实验”，were 后用过去分词构成被动语态 conducted。

q53.explanationZh: “上车前给售票员看车票”，conductor“售票员”，前面有 the 用名词。

q54.explanationZh: confuse A with B“把 A 和 B 搞混”，always 表示经常，用一般现在时 confuse。

q55.explanationZh: congratulate sb. on sth.“就某事祝贺某人”，祝贺已经发生，用过去式 congratulated。

q56.explanationZh: absence from the conference“缺席会议”，conference“会议”。

q57.explanationZh: working conditions“工作条件”，表示“条件”时用复数 conditions。

q58.explanationZh: operate the computer“操作电脑”，computer“计算机”。

q59.explanationZh: reach a conclusion“得出结论”，后面 that 从句说明结论的内容。

q60.sampleAnswer: I have every reason to be confident of our victory.
references: I have every reason to be confident of our victory.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “有充分的理由”= have every reason to do；“对……有信心”= be confident of。

q61.sampleAnswer: It’s time for us to concentrate on what really matters.
references: It’s time for us to concentrate on what really matters.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “现在是……的时候了”= It’s time for sb. to do；“集中注意力于”= concentrate on；“要紧”= matter。

q62.sampleAnswer: He conducted a survey to find out students’ attitudes to English learning.
references: He conducted a survey to find out students’ attitudes to English learning.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “进行调查”= conduct a survey，叙述过去用 conducted；“对……的态度”= attitude(s) to...。

q63.sampleAnswer: He warmly congratulated me on my good exam result.
references: He warmly congratulated me on my good exam result.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “就某事祝贺某人”= congratulate sb. on sth.，叙述过去用 congratulated。

q64.sampleAnswer: I feel quite confident that I will pass the exam this time.
references: I feel quite confident that I will pass the exam this time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “对……有信心”可用 feel confident that + 从句；将来的事用 will。

q65.sampleAnswer: Somehow she connected the story with what she experienced in her childhood.
references: Somehow she connected the story with what she experienced in her childhood.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “不知怎么的”= somehow；“把 A 和 B 联系起来”= connect A with B；“她所经历的事”= what she experienced。

q66.sampleAnswer: If you have confidence in yourself, your dream is sure to come true.
references: If you have confidence in yourself, your dream is sure to come true.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “对……有信心”= have confidence in；“一定会”= be sure to do；“实现”= come true。

q67.sampleAnswer: It is commendable that a teacher has the courage to confess to having made mistakes to his students.
references: It is commendable that a teacher has the courage to confess to having made mistakes to his students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “难能可贵的”= commendable，用 It is... that... 结构；“承认做过某事”= confess to having done sth.。

q68.sampleAnswer: This newly released movie is meant to arouse the public’s concern about the frontier policemen, who risk their life to defend the national dignity of the country at any cost.
references: This newly released movie is meant to arouse the public’s concern about the frontier policemen, who risk their life to defend the national dignity of the country at any cost.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “旨在”= be meant to；“对……的关注”= concern about；“冒着生命危险”= risk one’s life；“不惜一切代价”= at any cost。

q69.sampleAnswer: Cities have brought better life for people, but they have also caused population explosion, traffic congestion, environmental pollution, resource depletion and friction between cultures.
references: Cities have brought better life for people, but they have also caused population explosion, traffic congestion, environmental pollution, resource depletion and friction between cultures.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “交通拥挤”= traffic congestion；“人口膨胀”= population explosion；“文化摩擦”= friction between cultures。
